guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows an extreme anomaly in currencyservice_diskio (z-score > 4 trillion, spiking from a baseline of 0 to 4022.78), which directly correlates with massive latency increases in currencyservice and downstream timeouts in frontendservice. Trace data confirms all worst-case requests route through currencyservice, and the absence of log errors suggests the degradation is caused by resource exhaustion rather than application-level faults.

proposed_fix.description: Restart currencyservice pods to clear stuck I/O operations and verify attached volume capacity, as the sudden spike from a zero baseline indicates disk thrashing or a full storage volume.
